body: A hand shovel rests across a wash pail, both striped with yellow dust. The pail smells of crop spray; road tape is knotted through its handle.
title: Field dust on the wash pail

body: The radio dial is bound with a narrow strip of tape. Its battery has been replaced recently, although the callers barricaded here had no way to send a reply. Someone wanted them listening to one channel.
title: Frequency held through the siege
